args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage note (dated May 18) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The saved report label needs to be updated to Pellow Home Living so the supervisor stops searching under two names. Please check the report is still labelled that way, as the note is from May.
- To clear up the PHL acronym: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows (Pellucid Harbor Logistics), and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments (Pellow Home Living).

Let me know if you need anything else from the coastal side.

(Drafted by assistant for Sofia Marchetti and Bettina Kroll.)
